text1: A large energy-class capital ship, capable of long range punishment with it's hardpoint-mounted tachyon lance and it's ten auto-pulse laser cannons, Sure to make any opposing capital ship flee for it's life. However it's lack of many PD defenses and a shallow angled front-mounted shield make it vulnerable to attack from strike craft.

A double barreled hellbore mount, individual fire rate is decreased to prevent ship-wide meltdown.

A feared weapon platform, rarely deployed due to the complexity involved in manufacturing a built-up barrel that can safely fire 510mm high-explosive shaped charge rounds. When such a shell impacts a target, the Neumann effect causes the warhead to propel a jet of molten metal into the target's armor, vaporizing a small area, causing hull breaches, depressurization and extensive internal damage from the spall.
